title: Phoretic colloids (SIMD), re-issued with its own labkit packs (seeds 0 and 2, t=800): the same Janus composites travel 4.5-6.4 body lengths with the B cap held and then divide into two capped composites; labkit generation 10 and 9, max 9.3-9.7 body lengths; the reciprocal twin neither travels nor divides
summary: Fix for 20261026T0529-c33-phoretic-swimdivide-claim, which was imported without packs in its own directory. world.py is unchanged (the world of 20261026T0356-c33-phoretic-divide-claim). New labkit packs here, seeds 0 and 2, 1600 frames (t=800), the runs in which the claimed events happen: seed 0, 80 splits, 27 persistent, max generation 10, merge/split 1.16, 137 tracks >= 1 body length, max 9.3; seed 2, 53 / 24 / 9 / 1.3, 105 tracks, max 9.7. The same-lineage evidence is unchanged (particle identity, travel restarted at every merge): seed 0 track 286 travels 4.5 diameters and splits 109 -> 61 + 47 at t=537; seed 0 track 364 travels 5.3 and splits 46 -> 31 + 17 at t=664 (generation 10); seed 2 track 177 travels 6.4 and splits 33 -> 16 + 13 at t=298; 0 such lineages on seed 1. Matched reciprocal turnover twin (mu_A2 = +1, seed 0, t=400): 0/16 composites travel >= 3 diameters, 0 persistent splits, vs 10/19 and 23.

claims.statement: In runs from a uniform random particle mix (seeds 0 and 2), Janus composites (A body, B cap) grow on the closed food ledger, and some of them travel >= 3 body lengths with the cap held and then divide into two composites that each keep B: seed 0 tracks 286 (4.5 diameters, then 109 -> 61 + 47) and 364 (5.3, then 46 -> 31 + 17), seed 2 track 177 (6.4, then 33 -> 16 + 13); with reciprocal responses the same world gives neither travel nor division.
claims.track: seed 0, track 286 (research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T0529-c33-phoretic-swimdivide-claim/swimdivide_seed0_track286.png): a capped composite travels 4.5 of its diameters merger-free from t~424 to t=537, keeps its B cap, and divides at t=537 into 61 + 47 particles, each with B share 0.23; labkit pack/seed0 reaches generation 10

controls_run.D: same reciprocal twin: 0 persistent splits vs 23; research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T0356-c33-phoretic-divide-claim/tpack_off (turnover off): 0-1 persistent splits

limits: Rare: 3 swim-then-divide lineages among 132 particle-identity persistent splits on 3 seeds, none on seed 1. Seed 2's daughters are small (16 and 13 particles). The particle tracker and labkit's grid tracker are separate; the named tracks are particle-identity tracks. Reticulate genealogy (labkit merge/split 1.16-1.3). No boundary layer (20261026T0441-c33-phoretic-no-wall), so SIMD, not SIBMD; C:swim-divide is not met. Designed food ledger (E not claimed).
